versions.changelog:
- Initial release of free-tts: a dual-engine free TTS and voice cloning skill.
- Supports Fish Audio (83 languages, low latency, persistent voice cloning, free until 2026-08-31).
- Integrates Xiaomi MiMo V2.5 TTS (8 preset Chinese voices, text-based voice design, audio cloning, style/singing control, free for a limited time).
- Provides simple setup scripts for environment variables and engine connectivity checks.
- Includes workflow guidance for persistent/custom voice cloning, multi-language TTS, and advanced audio design features.
